identity.name: Novice Trainer
identity.description: As proof that you completed the Trainer Lord's exercises, you were gifted this.|This panel is very versatile, granting many useful parameters for anyone.
identity.topFlavorText: Proof that you completed the transdimensional beginner's tutorial.

identity.name: Veteran Trainer
identity.description: As proof that you completed the Trainer Lord's exercises, you were gifted this.|This panel is very offensive, granting many parameters geared towards dispatching foes quickly.
identity.topFlavorText: Proof that you completed the transdimensional intermediate's tutorial.

identity.name: Ghosty Presence
identity.description: Even the ever-iconic ghosty has things you can learn.|Just lean in and listen real good, they whisper dark things and touch your butt.
identity.topFlavorText: Slaying Ghostys is required in this game. Good job.

identity.name: Foreboding Mists
identity.description: This one tried to be menacing, but just dying your sheet red doesn't really count.
identity.topFlavorText: Red Ghostys are just as bad as others.

identity.name: Tortuous Threestep
identity.description: No one suspected that this ultra-evil entity known as \enemy[103] would drop a node.|Good thing you were ready for it.
identity.topFlavorText: The menacing spirit hisses at you even in node form.

identity.name: Spooky Aura
identity.description: The spooky is an ancient earthen spirit that was laid to rest centuries ago.|Here you are, disturbing its beauty rest like some kind of jackass- seriously, why?!
identity.topFlavorText: When the going gets tough, the ghosty levels up to a spooky.

identity.name: ==REBORN==
identity.description: The best panel ever, hands down. You only need to acquire it somehow!
identity.topFlavorText: Get this panel, you will not regret it.

identity.name: Otherworldly Dark
identity.description: Sometimes, the dead end up reaching back and touching you in ways you don't like-|Like murderously.

identity.name: Shade of Night
identity.description: When gloom overtakes us, just embrace it, really.|Nothing wrong with a little evil to balance good or whatever.
identity.topFlavorText: The touch of death is cold as ice.

identity.name: Vero Noctu
identity.description: They say that for all light there is darkness, but this darkness is counterbalanced by the night.
identity.topFlavorText: The darkness always falls- but not in the good way.

identity.name: Flame's Caress
identity.description: When the flames caress you, the power swells within.|It might be something else swelling, though.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill \Skill[214] when this node is maxed.

identity.name: Fiery Shuffle
identity.description: Wisps that perpetually explode are a nuisance to society- and also drop pretty aggressive nodes.

identity.name: Yokai Blaze
identity.description: Killing the already-dead is an impressive feat.|Not like you cared or could even tell since it was taking fiery swings at ya like a douchebag.
identity.topFlavorText: The wrathful blaze of a dead dead thing is scary.

identity.name: Boney Situation
identity.description: The skeleton is an age-old RPG enemy- often frail and wimpy.|These skeletors live up to that expectation in spades.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill "Backstep" when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Spinal Control
identity.description: When the opportunity to smash up skeletons comes about, one must accept.|Smashing up skeledoggos is no exception to this hardfast rule.
identity.topFlavorText: The benefits of the dead should be weighed carefully.

identity.name: Don Armor
identity.description: When spooky enemies don armor, they become a little different.
identity.topFlavorText: Even floaty armor has a point.

identity.name: Plate Menace
identity.description: Sentient armor whose soul plunges deeper into despair, a truly scary fiend|that you felled all on your lonesome.
identity.topFlavorText: Paper-thin vitals, iron-thick attitude.

identity.name: Princely Flourish
identity.description: Regally speaking, one should verily be theoretically flourishing preposterously nonstop.|Indubitibly🧐.
identity.topFlavorText: Be mindful of the poison, because poison fuckin' hurts and there are no antidotes.

identity.name: Vice Fangs
identity.description: The golden viper bears the deadliest poison in all of Erocia.|Claiming its crown- its incisors- was ruthless, but a \_real\_ power move.
identity.topFlavorText: A viper's fangs are sharp as ... things that are very sharp.

identity.name: Gasp King
identity.description: Deadly snakes that do deadly things should be made ded faster than they ded you.
identity.topFlavorText: You dedded this snake so gud.

identity.name: Dragonic Sacrifice
identity.description: The dargins of Erocia can vary wildly in shape, size, color, and elemental affinity.|The Lesser Dargins are known for their petite stature, but they are still formidible.

identity.name: Arctica Chillius
identity.description: The dargins of Erocia can vary wildly in shape, size, color, and elemental affinity.|The Chilly Wyverns are known for being careful and calculating.
identity.topFlavorText: Something something witty something.

identity.name: Lamian Revelry
identity.description:
Watching them pulse and writhe as they wound up that massive laser|
was a tempting and alluring thing to behold.

identity.name: Impish Insight
identity.description: The insight of the kappa is literally dripping with moisture.|Incase you're not sure what that means, neither am I.

identity.name: Captain of the Kaps
identity.description: Once in a literal blue moon- not the metaphorical one- the captain of kappas emerge to feast.|They eat a lot of things, but what they eat isn't as important as this sweet sweet node.
identity.topFlavorText: Even kappas have a captain, apparently.

identity.name: River Runs Deep
identity.description: In some regions, kappa have come together in a sort of community and begun showing more civilized behavior.|This particular kappa appears to communicate with some sort of higher deity... I wonder if we'll meet them later?
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill "Energy Beam" when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Kappan Dirty Tricks
identity.description: Not all kappas are magical and worship their deities.|Some are guards for said shamans, and they really like playing dirty.
identity.topFlavorText: When you're just a shark-man, you sometimes need a dirty trick or two to win.

identity.name: Bounding Joy
identity.description: Cave frogs do hippity hop and lickity spit as annoyingly as you would expect.

identity.name: Ribbit Burps
identity.description: When reaching the frogs is harder, they seem to somehow become more annoying and will teach you the same.

identity.name: Crabtastical Crunchiness
identity.description: The crabs of Volcanis are no joke, what with them constantly trying to keep you rooted in-place.|It is unclear how they exist in such a hot area without just being cooked by the ambient temperature.
identity.topFlavorText: Combo crabs are the worst- not even good enough for eating.

identity.name: Slimestep
identity.description: A slime in the depths of some no-name cave in Erocia wielded great four-step moves.|Learn from the master and step on your enemies how they like it.
identity.topFlavorText: "Slimes just aren't as strong as they used to be." --Rupert

identity.name: Goo Tango
identity.description: The wilds around Raevula are home to the slimes bearing this node.|Like ghostys, these desert-themed slimes should be eradicated without mercy.
identity.topFlavorText: You can still hear their exotic throbbing while you gaze at the node.

identity.name: The Jigglejest
identity.description: TODO
identity.topFlavorText: TODO

identity.name: Romping Dessert
identity.description: A slime literally in a dark ass basin apparently had this node.|This slime doesn't appear much different from normal slimes, but \skill[230] sure does hurt.
identity.topFlavorText: Liquifaction is a state of being, according to slimes.

identity.name: Temporal Tapdance
identity.description: While some slimes just absorb your essence through material breakdown,|others are more inclined to melt your face off from another dimension.
identity.topFlavorText: Why do all slimes want to absorb you???

identity.name: Mostly-Seeing Eyes
identity.description: It was a stretch to call this a slime, but then you see its tentacles.|Known for gorging on bearcats during the winter, apparently.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill "Brainfog" when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Impenetrable Gazes
identity.description: This variant of roper has seen so much moisture that even its blobby ropes splash about when cracked.|Bondage not included.
identity.topFlavorText: Whippy ropes galore.

identity.name: Flowing Fluids
identity.description: May the fluids flow and... not ebb, that would be weird. Especially from a Jelli.|Don't do that.
identity.topFlavorText: The jelly's luminance has been extinguished. 💔

identity.name: Jelicious Jaunt
identity.description: The corpse of this thing has some rather jiggly elements that remind you of a certain other jiggly asset...
identity.topFlavorText: What a massive fucking jelli carrying around this node.

identity.name: Soak 'n' Spray
identity.description: Apparently, this planet has somehow managed to evolve water bats.|We aren't talking about bats that like water, we're talking bats MADE OF WATER.
identity.topFlavorText: Bats that are made of water are just as stupid as those that aren't.

identity.name: Mystic Gooping
identity.description: TODO (magi-goobat)
identity.topFlavorText: TODO

identity.name: Tentacular Touch
identity.description: Sometimes you just need to reach out and slap a lot of people at once.
identity.topFlavorText: Whip it good.

identity.name: Bloody Embrace
identity.description: The poison of the bloodtrap is extremely dangerous.|Even a few drops can weaken the body enough to be devourable by the trap.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill "Sap" when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Pissed Off Sprout
identity.description: The rage of a sprout (such as a Fungrowth) should never be underestimated.|Never forget.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill "Rage Growth" when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Spiritual Shrooming
identity.description:
Fungrowths that have ceased to exist actually don't cease to exist in this realm,
they just respawn as ghosty versions and are much more menacing.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn their trademark skill upon maxing this panel.

identity.name: Scorn of Fae
identity.description: Fae's have always been the kings of being able to piss you off by throwing rocks at you.|But soon, you too will be able to piss people off by throwing rocks at them!
identity.topFlavorText: Learn this enemy's trademark skill upon mastering the node.

identity.name: Regius Terra
identity.description: TODO
identity.topFlavorText: TODO

identity.name: Unseelie Court
identity.description: When the unseelie chaos can be encapsulated, it can eventually be converted into a battery to fuel your stats ala this node!
identity.topFlavorText: Learn this enemy's trademark skill upon mastering the node.

identity.name: Bearfisting It
identity.description: Why put a glove on it when you can just bearfist it instead?|Bearfisting is an ancient technique passed down from grizzly to grizzly.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill "Heavy Blow" when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Stone's Secret
identity.description: The panel derived from centuries of breeding. Not selective or anything, just regular ol' breeding.|Probably started with a goal in mind, but ya know, bear urges happened.
identity.topFlavorText: It was rather difficult finding this panel on the bear considering it had fur made of stone.

identity.name: Descend into Darkness
identity.description: A void-consumed bear proved difficult to defeat considering its vast amount of life, but at least|you managed to pry this node from its dead bear mitts.
identity.topFlavorText: The deepest desires of a bear apparently have always been to descend into darkness.

identity.name: Voidal Rendering
identity.description: TODO
identity.topFlavorText: TODO

identity.name: Skies of the Cave
identity.description: Bats are vicious and obnoxious creatures|They are renowned far and wide for slaying young would-be protagonists.
identity.topFlavorText: You truly can never chop up enough bats. You're doing the cave a favor.

identity.name: Crimson Gaze
identity.description: An ever-iconic eyeball with wings. They can be found all across the universe for some reason.|This one however, appears to be wrapped in flames, which makes it rather annoying to get close to.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill \Skill[248] when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Call from the Dark
identity.description: TODO
identity.topFlavorText: TODO

identity.name: Answer from the Dark
identity.description: TODO
identity.topFlavorText: TODO

identity.name: Crazy Beak
identity.description: TODO
identity.topFlavorText: TODO

identity.name: Resourceful Ratactics
identity.description: Rats manage to thrive in nearly all environments, including flooded rivers.|Channel your inner rat and get resourceful.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill "Tumble" when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Sting like a Bee
identity.description: The lessons learned by all of the slain needlers in the land.|Slaying these pests not only make you feel better, but also help "the people".

identity.name: Pressure Points
identity.description: These appear to be just off-colored Needlers, but they are exponentially more vicious!|The speed of these things is insane, and now yours can be, too.

identity.name: Drillsation
identity.description:
Much much more than your average bumblebee, this ruthless stinger has evolved in the harshest of wildernesses to execute even mighty megataurs in a single blow.
Crits truly are deadly and piss everyone off.

identity.name: Burrow Burr
identity.description: An ancient panel with a burr still in it.|Who knows what we'll be able to do with it.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill "Void Spiral" when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Living Volcano
identity.description: While the burrowing worms are scary, worms that burrow through lava are even more frightening.|Their \Skill[425] is nothing to shake a stick at, so shove that stick down their throat and spare yourself the burns.
identity.topFlavorText: Why did worms have to become immune to magma and be so aggressive?

identity.name: Wriggle Dansu
identity.description:
In the far off mountains there is a legend that worms dance. No one knows why, but it is wildly entertaining to watch.
Watch it once and you'll be addicted to doing it yourself for all eternity.
identity.topFlavorText: Why can't worms of Erocia just be regular poop-loving soil-burrowing worms?

identity.name: Bullheaded
identity.description: Being bullheaded isn't always a bad thing.|He grew to be big and strong from a little cow before you slayed him!
identity.topFlavorText: Be strong and tenacious like the bull. Or pretend at least.

identity.name: Ironfist of Iron
identity.description: The terror of the megataurs are known far and wide.|Deleting them would save hundreds of lives per year.
identity.topFlavorText: The one with the iron fist of iron will rule.

identity.name: Orcan Obediance
identity.description: The most scrubby and pathetic orc.|It mines and mines and mines. Fortunately it has tireless stamina.
identity.topFlavorText: Abuse the excessive endurance in the name of grinding.

identity.name: Orcan Brutality
identity.description: TODO
identity.topFlavorText: TODO

identity.name: Orcan Stormcalling
identity.description: Upper eschelons of orcs are oft heavily intuned with nature, allowing manipulation of the elements.|Thunder is deadly to manipulate, so why not learn it yourself?
identity.topFlavorText: Learn \Skill[247] when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Orcan Management
identity.description: TODO
identity.topFlavorText: TODO

identity.name: Orcan Mountaineering
identity.description:
Orcs that are capable of countering are mean douchebags deserving of getting kicked in the face-
hopefully that was precisely what you did to acquire this node.
identity.topFlavorText: A deadly orc in the mountains that was very deadly and deadly and also kinda chonky.

identity.name: Thief's Code
identity.description: The thief's code describes all sorts of various rules.|They are really more like guidelines, though.
identity.topFlavorText: Learn the skill "Shockwave" when this panel is maxed.

identity.name: Outlaw's Shortcuts
identity.description: In the north eastern reaches of Erocia, disaster appears to have struck.|Bandits leveled up their game and transcended to outlaws, making your life that much harder.
identity.topFlavorText: Even bandits need to step up their game from time to time.

identity.name: Dark Alley Deals
identity.description: TODO
identity.topFlavorText: TODO

identity.name: Titan's Girth
identity.description: Titans are a mighty race, surpassed only by folks who have guns, because guns obviously.|You really can just end a lot of life if you get good at shooting shit.
identity.topFlavorText: A mighty foe drops a mighty panel.

identity.name: Rampaging Ignition
identity.description: Its not blond babes shooting guns everywhere, but it does teach you how to respond with fire for anything.

identity.name: Splashback in Style
identity.description: It isn't clear why anyone would embrace splashback except as revenge, which is perfectly acceptable here.

identity.name: Electric Boogyman
identity.description: Shocking revelations are found everywhere, including places that enable you to shock back.

identity.name: Glutton's Dogma
identity.description: The dogma of the Glutton is held above all else: "thou must satiate thine hunger".
identity.topFlavorText: This node radiates with a strange energy...

identity.name: Wrath's Dogma
identity.description: The dogma of Wrath is held above all else: "thou must satiate thine revenge".
identity.topFlavorText: This node radiates with a strange energy...
